assets.name: port-quay
assets.prompt: Contemporary Takoradi commercial port, Ghana. Warm detailed gouache and colored-pencil style. Side-on cargo ship across left two thirds with a straight empty cargo deck at 52 percent image height, running from 12 to 62 percent of image width. Dark hull below, bridge farther back near 70 percent. Crane upper right, textured quay and open right third for a separately composited dockworker. assets.redrawn: Cold review: flat cargo deck aligned to counted overlays; retained the established port style.
